name: Me
overview: Scripture reveals a personal and powerful relationship between God and the individual, emphasizing His intimate knowledge and love for us even before our birth, as seen in Jeremiah 1:5 and Isaiah 43:4. God assures us of His presence and strength in times of fear and uncertainty (Joshua 1:9; Isaiah 41:10), promising peace and a hopeful future (Jeremiah 29:11). The ultimate expression of God's love is demonstrated in the giving of His Son, offering eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16). These verses collectively affirm that God not only accepts and loves us but also calls us to draw near to Him with confidence and trust.
